ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ أَذِقْنَا لَذَّةَ الْوِصَالِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa adhiqnā ladhdhata ‘l-wiṣāl.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and let us taste the pleasure of reunion!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ كَمَلَةِ الرِّجَالِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Kamalati ‘r-rijāl.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the most complete of men!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ السَّيِّدِ الْهُمَامِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Sayyidi ‘l-humām.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the chief of the gallant!
